en.name: Sets building restrictions along Auxiliary Route 233 and revises them in nearby areas
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Restrictions on Buildings within the Areas of Nerima City District Plans
en.summary: The ordinance sets building restrictions within the district plan area for the Auxiliary Route 233 roadside district. It also revises building restrictions in the adjacent Auxiliary Route 230 Oizumimachi 3-chome District and Auxiliary Route 230 Oizumigakuencho District following changes to urban planning. It takes effect on July 1, 2026.
